short_description: Fast, private real-time messaging with live location, media & auto-delete.
full_description:
QChat is a high-speed, modern real-time messaging application designed for fast, seamless communication across mobile and desktop devices.

✨ Key Features:
• Instant Messaging: Fast real-time chatting with read receipts (single check / double check).
• Live GPS Location: Share your real-time GPS location with live radar and tracking or send static pinned locations.
• Rich Media Support: Send photos, videos, voice audio notes, files, contacts, and stickers.
• 24-Hour Disappearing Media: Images expire after 24 hours on the server while safely preserved in device memory.
• Message Management: Edit messages within 30 minutes, or delete messages for everyone or only for yourself.
• Group & Direct Chats: Create custom groups or chat one-on-one with online status indicators.
• Dark & Day Themes: Beautiful Emerald Day theme and Sleek Midnight Dark theme.

Enjoy safe, lightning-fast communication with QChat!
